context_of_use: Numerical research verification of declared synthetic mechanical models; no clinical, athlete-performance or device decisions
population: Manufactured adult anthropometry; no empirical human cohort admitted
cell_rule: Cartesian product of primary_movements and domains; no silent omission or promotion of pending/refused cells

MATHEMATICS.claim: Correct equations, SI units and frames
MATHEMATICS.oracle: Analytic solutions, coordinate and time-origin invariance
MATHEMATICS.falsifier: Wrong gravity, units or rotated force frame

NUMERICS.acceptance: Observed refinement with predeclared quantity-specific error budgets

MULTIBODY.claim: Articulated momentum, inertia and constraint closure
MULTIBODY.oracle: Independent Newton-Euler force and impulse integration
MULTIBODY.acceptance: Existing I2 momentum budget applies only to its bounded momentum subclaim

CONTACT_ENERGY.claim: Admissible finite or impulsive contact with energy closure
CONTACT_ENERGY.oracle: Potential gradient, impulse momentum, friction cone and work ledger
CONTACT_ENERGY.falsifier: Adhesion, energy creation, absent catch impulse or excess friction

ANATOMY.claim: Declared joint and segment geometry is feasible
ANATOMY.oracle: Independent segment reach and joint range constraints
ANATOMY.falsifier: Impossible grip, penetration or missing spatial catch DOFs
ANATOMY.acceptance: No anatomical promotion beyond explicitly modeled DOFs

NEUROMUSCULAR.oracle: Declared capacity, activation and work limits
NEUROMUSCULAR.falsifier: Unbounded torque or neural inference from artificial control

MOVEMENT.claim: Physical start, event topology and completion
MOVEMENT.oracle: Contact and state predicates independent of controller labels
MOVEMENT.falsifier: False completion, missed rebound or fake receiving
MOVEMENT.acceptance: All required physical events and recovery must exist

MEASUREMENT.claim: Simulated FORCE/LPT conforms to declared acquisition
MEASUREMENT.oracle: Native clock, cable geometry, calibration and provenance contracts
MEASUREMENT.falsifier: Clock shift, substituted COM displacement or altered original zero
MEASUREMENT.acceptance: Existing paired-source admission plus exercise-specific measurement budgets

IDENTIFIABILITY.oracle: Matched-source different-latent counterexamples and support ledger
IDENTIFIABILITY.falsifier: Feet-only whole-system power or anatomical labels from scalar channels

BIOLOGY.falsifier: Ineligible population, leaked calibration split or absent rights
BIOLOGY.acceptance: NOT_EVALUABLE without admitted data and predeclared agreement margins

RELIABILITY_UNCERTAINTY.oracle: Independent regeneration, perturbations and experimental repeats where admitted
RELIABILITY_UNCERTAINTY.acceptance: Separate numerical, parametric, device and biological uncertainties

INTEGRITY.claim: Independent reproducible provenance and honest denominators
INTEGRITY.oracle: Exact SHA, hashes, source boundaries and adversarial admission
INTEGRITY.falsifier: Forged/nonfinite evidence, TRUTH leakage or omitted refusal cells
INTEGRITY.acceptance: No independent final-SHA acceptance by implementation author

empirical_data_policy: No recordings admitted; source rights and experimental matching required before any pilot
